title: Extract autonomous B-type quotient jobs; prove the remaining A-path loses for every p and C
body:
PR4654's type-B pair is `diag(D,QD) Sy(Q^-1) = [[D,0],[D,QD]]`. One ordinary output subtraction `Y -= X` therefore makes its two arbitrary inputs autonomous rank-7/rank-8 Gaussian jobs. The exact inverse-transpose orientation uses output `X += Y`, retaining the supplied source monomial conjugations. No Q^-1=Q shortcut, clean input or extra Gaussian call is used.

After extracting all 56 B pairs, the supplier has 56 active A pairs and 520 independent helpers, with helper rank mass 4246 and paid rank mass 5094. The remaining center excess is 64.

The new theorem rejects the unchanged minimal-cut A-path for **every p>=1, every split, every native/thin stage subset and every 0<=C<1**. Its complete moment satisfies `F(C) <= -(8*n+56)*7^(-C) < 0`, where n is its full-call count. The proof normalizes at rank seven and explicitly charges the paid rank-eight terms. This extends a negative finite search to an all-p/all-moment result for this precise consumer, without excluding mixed controllers that keep B ports active, changed phase schedules, words, centers or output contracts.

The constructive target is now specific: save at least nine integer rank units in the retained center excess per full call to cross the positive-rank-surplus threshold for this interface. That is necessary for positive rank surplus, not a sufficient moment, native, compiler or outer certificate. No higher kappa is claimed; selected conditional .00302015 remains unchanged.

Validation on Linux CPython 3.12.15: registered and isolated optimized replays pass; exact original source Git blobs and both native paid censuses; both Laurent matrix identities and sign/orientation/Q controls; all 2,504 complete split/support invoices through p=4; rational derivative certificate stronger than 1980/7; committed bytes and source-history preflight. The universal conclusion is the written proof, not extrapolation. PR4654's typed native theorem is a premise and its full phase/632-row proof is not independently re-audited here.

Only research/typed-quotient-path/ is added.
